scope: New quantum-sensing line; R8 and raw shared flags remain closed.
model: Coherent three-level ladder, rectangular pulses; hbar=tau=1; H=Delta|2><2|+delta_q Z/2+Omega(1+epsilon)/2 [exp(-i phi)(|0><1|+eta|1><2|)+h.c.]+b cos(pi t) Z/2. Z=diag(1,-1,0).
candidate: s_j=r_j*r_(j+1), j=0..N-1; r_j=(-1)^(popcount(j & (j>>1))); phases 0 or pi; N a power of two, N>=4.
mechanism_claim: At b=delta_q=epsilon=eta=0, the eta derivative of the leakage row has norm at most a*sqrt(N)+c, uniformly in real Delta. a=(Omega/2)*abs(Is-exp(-i Delta tau)*Ic), c=Omega*abs(Ic). This is a leading-order coefficient bound, not a fixed-eta all-N leakage guarantee.
candidate_selection: Algebraically constructed before numerical tests; no phase, detuning, protocol or threshold fitting.

engineering_screen.measurement: P_plus_y versus I-P_plus_y; leaked shots retained, not postselected
engineering_screen.metric: Classical local Fisher information for b at b=0 divided by N*tau+overhead; exact linear response during finite pulses and free intervals
engineering_screen.screening_condition: candidate minimum information rate over the entire frozen grid >= 2 times the largest baseline minimum, and candidate ideal FI >= 0.95*CP ideal FI
engineering_screen.interpretation: Twofold is a preliminary local screening threshold, NOT the mission's order-of-magnitude real-workflow gate. Grid minima are not continuous-domain guarantees. Parameters are synthetic, not calibrated to a device.

decisions.incorrect_formula_or_bound: REFUTED_MECHANISM; preserve counterexample; no silent retuning
decisions.novelty_gate: UNKNOWN until exact prior-art equivalence audit and independent scrutiny

execution: Local NumPy only; no hardware, paid endpoints, external publication, outreach or terms approval. Source/protocol committed before run. Existing output directories rejected.
